{{External|rs|rsc=Black Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black chainbody |image = [[File:Black chainbody.png]] |release = [[8 December]] [[2001]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (8 December 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 1440 |weight = 6.803 |exchange = Yes |id = 1107 }} [[File:Black chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''black chainbody''' is stronger than the [[steel chainbody]], and can be worn by players with 10 [[Defence]]. Players can purchase this item at the [[Keldagrim]] and [[Falador]] [[Chainmail shops]]. This item cannot be made using the [[Smithing]] skill, and has the same bonuses as a [[white chainbody]], except it lacks a [[prayer bonus]]. Sold at [[Wayne's Chains]] shop in southern Falador for 1,440 coins, and at [[Saro]]'s armour shop in Keldagrim for 1,872 coins. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black chainbody cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +22 |dslash = +32 |dcrush = +39 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +24 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Black chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Black chainbody equipped female.png]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black chainbody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Black chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Black chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
